judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The img is a 24px colour swatch (a brown circle in the crop and screenshot) and the only content of a focusable div role=button in the Paul Costelloe faux fur hat tile; the button's name, from contents, is 'swatch'. claimTrue: the button holds only this img with alt 'swatch', which does not say what the button does (select the Brown variant), so the sentence holds. elementFails: 'swatch' is placeholder text that conveys neither the colour nor the control's purpose (F30; H30/G82), so the image fails 1.1.1 even though the product name happens to contain 'Brown'; the button also fails 4.1.2 for the same reason. captureDiffers: the capture is a styled, rendered page (screenshot matches the live layout); the Gifts for Her shelf is rendered client-side so my fetch could not show these exact tiles, but the live page's product data labels every swatch image 'swatch' (imageLabel), which VTEX's SKU selector uses as the img alt, so users get the same alt. True positive.
